page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Marginal notes in the right margin: "Westerwoldij." beside the line "limiti ad Dullarti finem", and a black-letter note "Dat Gho bnd Woldrecht." lower down. Running head at top centre, page number top right, catchword below the last line at right.

main_text.p: deriæ quondam accensa, Tiammâ rivulo è paludibus defluente à proximis dirempta, nomine hoc ne nunc quidem istic obliterato, capite ejus Winscota. Tota verò hæc ab Amaso ad austrinum limitem civitati Groningæ ab annis propè cc bonis conditionibus paret. Ejus austrino Westerwoldij. limiti ad Dullarti finem Westerwoldij connectuntur, & ipsi Reideriorum quondam pars, hinc porrò in latere ortivo Dullarti ejusdem secundùm Amasum longo tractu duobus magnis milliaribus, & dimidio haud breviore pertinentium: hi vicis censentur quinque, agrumque colunt, nisi quantum Dullarto sinui proximum est, haud felicem, ac paludosæ ferè naturæ: in quos imperium, aut imperii umbram habuit multis sæculis Addingia familia nobilis, Weddæ arcis vetustæ eodem in agro domina, Westerwoldico cognomine posteris quàm gentili notior: nunc ad Arembergios omnia translata.
Postremò territorium suburbanum est Dat Gho[?] bnd Woldrecht.totius regionis fines ad austrum longo tractu contrà Drentiam tuens, vicos ambitu suo continens xii cum sanis rusticis

page.notes: The black-letter marginal note is read as "Dat Gho bnd Woldrecht."; the word after "Gho" is uncertain, and the note's line breaks are not reproduced. The catchword "vi,&" is doubtful. The ligature in "conne[ct]untur" is read as "connectuntur". The note placement within the second paragraph is approximate, since the note stands beside several lines. No headings or reference marks in the text are visible.
